about: The `report_anomalies` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is fy 2022 only.

rows.table: Monty Tech budget figures and expense breakdown (chart did not extract)
rows.detail: Record this as a KNOWN GAP, not as absent data.
The heading appears ONLY on p117; pp118-119 continue the same roster with no repeated heading.

rows.table: Salary Administration Plan bylaw (full reprinted text, ATM Article 22)
rows.detail: Not a table but it CONTAINS several: the vacation accrual schedule (p158-159), sick-leave buyback percentages by service length ('10 years continuous service 10%; 15 years continuous service 50%; 25 years continuous service 75%', p160), the progressive discipline steps (p163), and the part-time proration formula worked example (p163).
11 + 32 = 43, not the printed 44 - the page's own arithmetic is off by one, or one row is uncounted.

Twelve pages (153-164) of the report are the complete reprinted text of the Town's Salary Administration Plan bylaw, printed with additions underlined and deletions struck through. The extract loses that formatting entirely, so from the text alone you cannot tell current bylaw from proposed amendment.

rows.table: Annual Town Election official tally sheet, 21 May 2022
rows.detail: TWO DATA DEFECTS TO NOTE: the School Committee 2-year block is printed TWICE, once on p175 (spelling the candidate 'ANTHONY FRANKSCULIMBRENE II') and again on p176 ('ANTHONY FRANK SCULIMBRENE II') with identical vote counts; and the Planning Board block shows the elected candidate 'AMANDA REID' with 2 votes against 13 all-others and 162 blanks, which suggests she was a write-in whose name was not on the ballot.

rows.table: Fiscal Year 2023 capital plan (Capital Planning Committee report)
rows.detail: The plan is also referenced (but NOT reprinted) inside the town meeting excerpts at p142 - the opposite of FY2021, which printed the table twice.

rows.table: Turkey Hill Elementary School staff roster
rows.detail: NO HEADING - FY2021 printed 'THES STAFF ROSTER' over the same roster;
FY2021 split this into two separate unheaded rosters (LMS on its p118, LHS on its p121);

The Annual Town Election of 21 May 2022 drew 177 ballots from 8,903 registered voters - about 2% turnout - and every single race was uncontested. Six months later the state election drew 5,335 ballots (59%). Both tally sheets are printed in full in the same report.
A full 20-grade by 8-step hourly wage grid is printed at p152, as voted. FY2021 prints no such grid, so this is available for one year and not the other.

The Town holds shares of Unitil stock inside two trust bequests ('MABEL ALLEN UNITIL STOCK #20376' and 'JOSEPH HARWOOD UNITIL STOCK', p43) - equity in the local utility, held in nineteenth-century trusts.

The Vital Records page (p140) explains that names were removed at the recommendation of the Registry of Vital Records and the US Department of State, and only counts are now published. That is a documented change of practice, and it is what makes FY2021's missing vitals page (scan failure) impossible to compensate for from this year.
The oldest live capital appropriation on the books is Article 3006 from the August 2002 Annual Town Meeting, 'Development of Cemeteries', still carrying a balance twenty years later (p38).
'Old Primary School Hazardous Abatement' closes FY2022 at NEGATIVE $49,990.00 in the special revenue funds table (p37) - a fund spent into deficit.
The cemetery page's own totals do not add up: 11 full burials plus 32 cremations against a printed Total of 44. FY2021's version has the same defect (37 and 46).
A 'TNC Per Ride Assessment Fund' appears in the special revenue funds - the town's share of the state per-trip assessment on Uber and Lyft rides, running at about $400 a year.
ARPA money is visible as CASH: 'Unibank ARPA CLFRF Fund $1,754,181.32' sits in the Treasurer's account list (p40) while never appearing as a revenue line in the receipts summary.

The town profile panel (p6) prints TOTAL AREA - 26.63 MILES while the prose four lines below says 'approximately 26.4 square miles'. The report contradicts itself on one page, and the FY2021 report carries the same pair.

The School Committee 2-year election block is printed twice (pp175 and 176) with the candidate's surname spelled two different ways and identical vote counts - the same race counted once but typeset twice.

rows.table: FY2022 collection of taxes - receivables summary
rows.detail: Because the two years transposed differently in OCR, cross-checking a levy line between FY2021 and FY2022 means re-deriving it from two differently-broken extracts; the closing balance in FY2021 should equal the opening in FY2022 for each line, which is the check to run.
Note the panel says 26.63 square miles while the prose immediately below says 'approximately 26.4 square miles' - the report contradicts itself on the same page.

The corresponding FY2021 page has no text layer and no OCR at all, so this is the only recoverable vitals figure across the two years.
